sine_flow_tray.name: What Will Leave? — Sine Contact Tray
sine_flow_tray.description: One stationary colliding sine heightfield receives 32 spheres. Change peak-to-trough relief or sphere radius between releases; compare outlet crossings, still-in bodies and other exits at a twelve-second deadline. A side console keeps the surface visible. RESET restores the declared 0.30 m relief and 75 mm radius. The tray complements the visible, noncolliding corridor in Sine Space.
interactions: SIZE changes sphere radius at fixed mass
RULE reveals the sampled sine and collision construction
sine_flow_tray.qfep_connection: A repeating field supplies different possibilities to different bodies. Presence at a deadline is measured; shelter, entropy and freedom need further questions and tests.
